name: sf-vault-bridge
description: Use Autodesk Vault and Inventor tools from Claude through your own running Inventor session (SF Vault Bridge add-in).
long_description: Relays Claude Desktop to the SF Vault Bridge Inventor add-in at http://localhost:8790/mcp. Start Inventor and sign in to Vault first. Writes are preview-first and need your confirmation in Claude.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Bridge and add-in status and version.

tools.name: vault_search_files
tools.description: Search Vault files by name or property.

tools.name: vault_get_file
tools.description: File properties, data card, lifecycle and compliance.

tools.name: vault_uses
tools.description: Children of a file with versions.

tools.name: inventor_open_bom
tools.description: Structured BOM of the active assembly in Inventor.

tools.name: fix_data_card_preview
tools.description: Preview a data card fix (no changes).

tools.name: fix_data_card_apply
tools.description: Apply a previewed data card fix; needs confirm.

tools.name: mcmaster_intake_preview
tools.description: Preview a McMaster part intake (no changes).

tools.name: mcmaster_intake_commit
tools.description: Commit a previewed McMaster intake; needs confirm.
